values.note: Reservations for the season open the first Monday in March at 8 am. Weekend stays carry a two-night minimum, holiday weekends three (2024 brochure).
City of Watertown: pads $30 a night, full-service pull-through pads $45, plus tax; $7 online booking fee ($10 by phone).

note: City of Watertown campground on the northeast shore of Lake Kampeska, with a swim beach, courtesy docks and a boat ramp in the park. Casino Speedway, a dirt track next door, races on Sunday nights. --Claude
